monitor.monitor_description:
The purpose of this monitor is to detect hardware errors in the REU that are reported in REU registers.
P3P3V_PRI_OK: This bit indicates that +3.3V power that supplies the PCDA interfaces is good. The digital signal comes from a microchip on the REU-D board that checks +3.3Vp. This bit is 0 when the voltage is below 3.08V. This bit is 1 when the voltage is above 3.08V for 200 ms.
PCU_PWR_OK: This bit indicates that the PCU power is good (PCU input power). The digital signal comes from PCU. The bit is 0 when input voltage is below 21V +/- 0.5V. The bit is 1 when input voltage has been above 22V for 30 ms 100 ms.
P1P5V_PWR_OK: This bit indicates that +1.5V power that supplies SRAM core power is good. The digital signal comes from the REU-D FPGA to represent goodness of FPGA output voltage to SRAM. The bit is 0 when the voltage is outside a 11% typical regulation window. BP_P3P3V_OK: This bit indicates that +3.3V power that supplies the REU module is good. The digital signal comes from PCU. This bit is 0 when the 3V3_PR output voltage is below 2.935V. This bit is 1 when the 3V3_PR output voltage is above 3.135V.
monitor.conditions: REU is on, resync is complete, REU FP is enabled, registers are valid.
